meta.title: Batch Image Format Converter - S-Jiffy
meta.description: Batch convert PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, AVIF, and HEIC images to JPG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF, covering all 12 conversion directions: PNG↔JPG, PNG↔WebP, JPG↔WebP, HEIC→PNG/JPG, AVIF→PNG/JPG, and SVG→PNG/JPG. Everything runs locally - files are never uploaded.
desc: Batch convert PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG, AVIF, and HEIC images to JPG, PNG, WebP, or AVIF, covering all 12 conversion directions: PNG↔JPG, PNG↔WebP, JPG↔WebP, HEIC→PNG/JPG, AVIF→PNG/JPG, and SVG→PNG/JPG. Everything runs locally - files are never uploaded.
